stem.en: A square matrix has determinant zero. What does this say about the transformation it represents?
stem.et: Ruutmaatriksi determinant on null. Mida see ütleb teisenduse kohta, mida maatriks esitab?

label.en: It collapses space to a lower dimension, so it has no inverse
label.et: See surub ruumi madalamasse mõõtmesse, seega pöördmaatriksit ei ole

label.en: Every entry of the matrix must be zero
label.et: Maatriksi iga element peab olema null

label.en: The matrix is not square, since only square matrices have determinants
label.et: Maatriks ei ole ruutmaatriks, sest determinant on ainult ruutmaatriksitel

label.en: A mistake was made, because a determinant cannot be zero
label.et: On tehtud viga, sest determinant ei saa olla null
